text_block_list.text:
At Каррен Тян's request, we reserve a
time for a
yoga lesson.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Apparently, it starts with meditation...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be really into it. I watch
over her
silently.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Boom! ♪ Boom! ♪
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that sound?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Woo! Time to raise the roof!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Whoa! Maruzen?! This is—
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Come dance on the platform with me,
Curren!
Everyone's gotta get jiggy!
TGIF! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: "Jiggy"? "TGIF"? ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Maruzen's so cute!
She's so cool! Sooo
pretty!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
No way. Everyone's looking at Maruzen
with stars
in their eyes. They're calling
her cute.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...Did the cutest Umamusume in the
world change
while I wasn't looking?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Oomph oomph oomph oomph! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Um, Maruzen? Do you mind if I dance
with you?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hearing the music really got me in the
mood. ♪
So can I—what was it again?
Can I "TGIF" with
you?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Oh? Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I like those eyes—the greed and the fire.
You
could get me excited with eyes like
those.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Aw, you've got me going! I've got some
cool
moves and words just for you... ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oomph oomph oomph! ♪ I'm totally
nailing it!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Totally tubular!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hooray! ♪ Let's keep this going till
morning,
everyone!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Where's Maruzen? Where's the
platform?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...A dream? No, it was more like a
completely
different world...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Oh! I must have found an unexplored
territory of
cuteness! I'm sure that made
me even cuter!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян's eyes sparkle. Her cuteness
and
sharpness are even more refined
than before!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
